classification: The source is a framework demonstration, not the mathematical source-of-truth registry of the Q0 Rate Program.

critical_findings.finding: The legacy ID R0 denotes an unbounded expansion remainder, not the canonical Q0 Gaussian-Sard/Morse-Smale condition R0.
The coefficient 0.4127, domain r∈(0,1], b∈[0,3], and three generic region bounds do not match the frozen Q0 theorem.
critical_findings.repair: Registry metadata labels the graph as a legacy schema demonstration.

critical_findings.finding: inner_bound, far_bound, and bdry_bound are labeled Proven without proof/evidence artifacts or numerical statements.
critical_findings.repair: Migrated as explicit open/Plausible conditions rather than nonconditional theorem support.

critical_findings.finding: C_const says 'closed form + numerical value' but provides only 0.4127 and an agreement-based tag with no independent-error certificate.
critical_findings.repair: Migrated as an open Measured condition.

critical_findings.finding: pinned_input is disconnected, while cm_node is attached to T_main despite no Gaussian-pinned support edge requiring the bridge.
critical_findings.repair: Both are retained as disconnected fixtures; the bridge no longer launders into the root.

critical_findings.finding: The union witness says the regions are disjoint, although a union bound requires neither disjointness nor independence.
critical_findings.repair: Typed as an exact UNION_BOUND witness.

critical_findings.finding: Endpoint truth is stored as Boolean values rather than as recomputable endpoint certificates.
critical_findings.repair: ENDPOINT-FIDELITY remains an active open gate.

critical_findings.finding: T_main prints PASS at Proven-Modulo under v1.2 while R0 is open and C_const is provisional.
critical_findings.repair: The v2.0 root report separates archive validity, candidate shell validity, conditional promotion, and unconditional promotion.

critical_findings.finding: Human labels such as C#1 are not cryptographic content hashes.
critical_findings.repair: Every target claim and edge uses canonical SHA-256.

critical_findings.finding: No coefficient assembly or full-domain uniformity certificate is present.
critical_findings.repair: COEFFICIENT-ASSEMBLY-SOURCE and UNIFORM-COEFFICIENT-CERTIFICATE remain open blockers.
